comment: Separate from payload_registry.json because PKGs use a different consumption model (package installer / fetchpkg-style tools, not pldmgr's autoloader). Same shape as the ELF/BIN registry, including backup_url (mirror/fallback source -- see payload_registry.json comment for the SHA-256 cross-verification note). Filenames must still follow {identity}[-{variant}]_v{version}.pkg to auto-associate -- official Sony content-id-style PKG filenames don't match that convention and will show up in 'check'/'validate' as needing manual review. Categories use the condensed 10-category list in categories.json v3.

default.author: nexgen999
default.note: Homebrew web browser packaged as a PKG. Fill in title_id/content_id if the dev publishes them -- not required for homebrew, only for official Sony content.

default.note: Native PS5 storefront/library browser PKG. Companion to ps5library-agent.elf -- the PKG installs the UI while the agent ELF provides the backend. SHA256SUMS file ships with each release. GPL-3.0.
